messages:
violet: Heads-up: I just hit a nasty onboarding footgun with the new SDK canary. yarn/pnpm users with workspace symlinks get a types resolution error and the edge bundler fails to tree-shake because the export map and types fields disagree. Repro in samples/next-starter.

ash: ugh. can you paste the published package.json exports + types fields from the tarball?

violet: sure, unpacked tarball shows:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./helpers/*": "./dist/helpers/*.js"
},
"types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts"
```
Note: we used "default" instead of "require" to try to be forgiving.

dom: that's the problem. Node conditional exports expect "require" not "default". Some bundlers will fall back differently when they can't match a condition, and TS resolution uses the "types" field path. If the CJS build is only present in dist/cjs and types points to dist/esm, PNPM's symlinked resolution ends up walking to the wrong entry and tsc says \"module not found\".

ash: ah, and I bet our pack process omitted dist/esm/index.d.ts for canaries due to a globby pattern change.

violet: exact repro: on a fresh machine with pnpm workspace:
```bash
pnpm i
node -v # 18.x
cd samples/next-starter
pnpm run build # fails: typescript error: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk' or its corresponding type declarations
```

ci-bot: CI job 980 (samples/next-starter) failed on branch canary: TS1008 type resolution error. logs: https://ci.internal/job/980

dom: quick fixes: 1) change export map to use both "import" and "require" keys rather than "default"; 2) ensure "types" points to a path present in the tarball (prefer dist/index.d.ts at the root), or ship separate type entry for cjs/esm (not ideal). 3) add a pnpm/yarn workspace smoke test that installs from the tarball via workspace-symlink and runs ts compile.

avital: (jumping in) we also saw ESM/CJS consumers break when package.json had both "module" and conditional exports because some bundlers prefer module/main. Might be related.

avital: short-term patch: republish canary with corrected exports: use "require" and include a top-level "main": "dist/cjs/index.js" and move types to "types": "dist/index.d.ts". Also include both dist/esm/index.d.ts and dist/cjs/index.d.ts.

ash: also add a pack-time sanity check that unpacks the generated tgz and validates these four things: exports contain import+require, subpath globs preserved, types file path exists, and tarball includes both esm and cjs JS files. If any check fails, fail the publish job.

violet: will open rollback + pack-fix PR. Also adding a note to devex onboarding that pnpm workspace symlinks can reveal these issues early.

release-bot: Created PR #1412 to revert canary + add pack-time checks and pnpm smoke test. CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1412

ci-bot: job 981 running: pnpm workspace smoke on node 18 queued.

dom: long-term: consider a single source-of-truth serializer for package.json exports (small util) that we run at build time so contributors don't hand-edit the map. Also add a GH Action that validates exported types + subpaths for every release tag.

violet: thanks, everyone. this one burned a couple of PM demos, so let's prioritize the pack checks. I'll follow up with an onboarding doc update and a short announce blurb once PR merges. :raised_hands:

ash: minor UX suggestion: add a one-liner in README about checking both import() and require() flows when changing exports. Saved my afternoon.

violet: agreed. posting in #announce after release.
